import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static double absValue(double n) {
        return n >= 0 ? n : -n;
    }

    public static int findNearest(int x, int y, int b) {
        double target = (double) x / y;
        int low = 0, high = 1000000;
        for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if ((double) mid / b < target)
                low = mid;
            else
                high = mid;
        }
        int bestA = low;
        double minDiff = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int a = low - 10; a <= high + 10; a++) {
            double diff = absValue((double) a / b - target);
            if (diff < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff;
                bestA = a;
            }
        }
        return bestA;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int optimalA = 0;
        int optimalB = 1;
        double minDiff = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
            int a = findNearest(x, y, b);
            double diff = absValue((double) a / b - (double) x / y);
            if (diff < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff;
                optimalA = a;
                optimalB = b;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(optimalA + "/" + optimalB);
        sc.close();
    }
}
